## Type of change

<!-- The pull request title follows Conventional Commits: type(scope): summary -->

- [ ] `feat` new behaviour
- [ ] `fix` bug fix
- [ ] `docs`, `test`, `refactor`, `ci`, `build` or `chore`
- [ ] Breaking change (`!` in the title, explained below)

## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] Self-review done: read the full diff once more before asking for the merge
- [ ] Tests added or changed (a bug fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] Contracts changed first, if the API or a document shape changed (`openapi.yaml`, `schemas/`)
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed; an ADR added for a lasting decision
- [ ] Release notes: breaking change, new tenant grant (stage 2 rerun) or new setting? Say so here
- [ ] No real tenant data and no secrets
